description: The people most active in the projects of an area (ckb, fiber, dob/spore, rgb++, ccc, nervos) or in the projects that match some words, with the projects they work on. Useful to find who to ask about a part of CKB.

limit.description: at most this many people, 10 by default

query.description: words that pick the projects, e.g. "wallet" or "spore"

name: who_works_on
title: Who works on what
